annotations.title: Connect the job seeker's VeritaHire account

description: Only for assistants that cannot sign in with OAuth (ChatGPT and Claude use their own Connect / sign-in button instead). For a person with a VeritaHire account who wants your help applying for jobs. Returns a link and a short code. The person opens the link on veritahire.com, signs in themselves and clicks Allow; then call finish_connecting with pair_secret. Takes no personal data. Never ask the person for their VeritaHire password or sign-in code.

ai_name.description: Your name as the person will see it on the Allow page, e.g. "Claude" or "ChatGPT"
